body:
Source: GitHub issue #647 (bug, P1-high, area:review; class false-green). Re-verified on main @ 5343b84b: packages/gate-fuzzing/lib/classify.mjs:51 `if (!surface || surface.length === 0) return false;` makes classifyCandidate return out-of-scope for every candidate against a gate with no surface, and an absent claims array makes every candidate wrong-claim. packages/gate-fuzzing/lib/gate-adapter.mjs:45 loadSuite only checks that suite.gates is a non-empty array. packages/gate-fuzzing/lib/fan.mjs:163 and :201 target gates round-robin (gates[i % gates.length]) including validity gates such as the README's own `build` gate, so part of every round's fan budget targets a gate that can never be defeated. Out-of-scope does not count as inconclusive, so such a run still reaches "dry" and prints clean with exit 0, having prosecuted nothing for that gate.

CONTEXT FOR THE BUILDER. Package `packages/gate-fuzzing`: bin/gate-fuzzing.mjs (CLI; loadSuite is called at the "load suite" block and a throw goes to opError, exit 1; `const gates = suite.gates` is then handed to buildPromptOnlyOutput and to the fan), lib/gate-adapter.mjs (loadSuite, substituteTokens, gate runner), lib/fan.mjs (fanAdversary, buildPromptOnlyOutput; round-robin over the gates it is given), lib/classify.mjs (classifyCandidate, intersectsSurface), lib/loop.mjs, lib/verdict.mjs. Suite schema is documented in packages/gate-fuzzing/README.md: each gate has name, run (argv array), cwd, and either `validity: true` (build/lint/typecheck anti-gaming gates) or surface (globs) + claims (property kinds). Tests: `npm test -w packages/gate-fuzzing` from the worktree root.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. loadSuite validates every gate after the existing non-empty check, through ONE exported pure function `validateSuiteGates(gates)` in lib/gate-adapter.mjs that returns a list of problem strings (empty = valid); loadSuite throws one Error joining them, prefixed with the suite path. Rules: each gate is a plain object with a non-empty string `name` and a non-empty `run` array; a gate without `validity: true` MUST have `surface` and `claims`, each a non-empty array of non-empty strings; the suite MUST contain at least one non-validity gate. Each problem names the gate (by name, or by index when name is missing) and the missing or malformed field, e.g. `gate "build2": missing or empty "surface" (required unless "validity": true)`.
2. The CLI keeps its existing contract: an invalid suite is an operational error, exit 1, message on stderr via opError, nothing on stdout, no manifest record, no model call.
3. Fan targets only fuzzable gates. Export `fuzzableGates(suite)` from lib/gate-adapter.mjs (the gates without `validity: true`) and have bin/gate-fuzzing.mjs hand that list, not suite.gates, to the fan and to --prompt-only output. classify still receives the full suite (validity gates must still run as validity checks).
4. Regression guard: the README's documented example suite (one rails-guard gate with surface+claims, one build gate with validity: true) still loads unchanged; classify.mjs keeps its current fail-closed treatment of an absent surface (defence in depth; do not edit it).
5. Documentation: update `packages/gate-fuzzing/README.md` and make the SAME edit by hand in `apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/gate-fuzzing.mdx` (hand-maintained mirror; never regenerate). State that surface and claims are required on every non-validity gate, that a suite must contain at least one non-validity gate, and that validity gates are never fan targets.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 A suite whose non-validity gate lacks surface, has surface: [], lacks claims, or has claims: [] is rejected by loadSuite with a message naming the gate and field. verify: `node --test packages/gate-fuzzing/test/suite-validation.test.mjs`
- AC2 A suite whose gates are all validity gates is rejected; a gate missing name or run is rejected. verify: `node --test packages/gate-fuzzing/test/suite-validation.test.mjs`
- AC3 The CLI given such a suite (--suite <tmp file> --prompt-only) exits 1 with the problem on stderr and empty stdout. verify: `node --test packages/gate-fuzzing/test/suite-validation.test.mjs`
- AC4 fuzzableGates excludes validity gates, and --prompt-only output for the README example suite contains no prompt targeting the build gate. verify: `node --test packages/gate-fuzzing/test/suite-validation.test.mjs`
- AC5 The README example suite still loads. verify: `node --test packages/gate-fuzzing/test/suite-validation.test.mjs`
- AC6 Existing suite green (if an existing test fixture suite now fails validation, fix the fixture and say so in the PR body). verify: `npm test -w packages/gate-fuzzing`
- AC7 Docs updated in both places. verify: `grep -c "validity: true" packages/gate-fuzzing/README.md apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/gate-fuzzing.mdx` (each >= 1, and the new requirement sentence present in both)
- AC8 Mutation gate green on the branch. verify: `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` exits 0 (also run `--max 80` once locally)

OUT OF SCOPE: issue #642 (adversary-supplied witnessSource), per-gate candidate/out-of-scope tallies in the report, detecting surface globs that match no file, any change to classify.mjs, oracle.mjs, provision.mjs or candidate.mjs.
title: gate-fuzzing: loadSuite rejects a non-validity gate without surface or claims, and fan targets only fuzzable gates
